key_components.live_scoreboard: High-contrast LED display showing Quarter, Clock, Down & Distance, Possession indicator, Timeouts, Home vs Away scores.
key_components.animated_field_canvas: 2D Football Field canvas or SVG displaying scrimmage line (blue line), first down line (yellow line), animated ball marker, player tokens, and play movement path animation.
key_components.dice_roller_widget: Interactive tabletop 2D6 / 2D20 roll animation trigger with tactile rolling motion, audio toggle effect, dice outcome display, and instant cross-reference lookup.
key_components.play_chart_matrix: Interactive lookup chart showing standard tabletop dice combinations (e.g. 2 to 12) mapped against Offense Rating vs Defense Rating to produce play outcomes (Pass Yds, Run Yds, Sacks, Incompletions, Interceptions, Fumbles, Touchdowns).
key_components.play_by_play_feed: Real-time scrollable ticker with animated play cards, yards gained/lost badges, player attribution tags, and play type filters.
key_components.box_score_modal: Comprehensive game statistics tabbed into Team Stats, Passing, Rushing, Receiving, Defense, and Kicking numbers.
key_components.season_dashboard: Interactive hub showing Standings table (W-L-T, PCT, PF, PA, Streak), Schedule & Results with Quick Sim / Play Game buttons, and Team Roster management sorted by rating/position.

testing_and_data_attributes.requirement: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, dice roll triggers, simulation controls, and key metrics MUST have explicit data-testid attributes.
testing_and_data_attributes.convention: kebab-case role-based format (e.g. data-testid='roll-dice-btn', data-testid='play-chart-toggle-btn', data-testid='team-select-card-KC')

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components in /app/frontend/src/components/ and /app/frontend/src/components/ui/
Ensure Google Font links for Barlow Condensed and JetBrains Mono are included in public/index.html or imported in index.css
Build a robust deterministic simulation engine with seed data covering all 32 NFL teams with realistic 2025 ratings (Offense, Defense, Special Teams, QB, RB, WR, DEF stars)
Implement tabletop dice roll logic: 2D6 roll (range 2-12) cross-referenced against offensive rating vs defensive rating to determine yards gained, turnover, incomplete pass, sack, or touchdown
Provide interactive animated 2D field canvas/SVG with yard lines, endzones, line of scrimmage, first down marker, and animated play trajectory
Include play-by-play visual execution: when dice is rolled, show rolling dice animation -> highlight corresponding cell on the Play Matrix -> move ball on field -> append event to play-by-play log
Include a Play Chart Visualizer tab/modal so players can view the complete probability chart and how ratings modify dice rolls
Support full Season Mode: 18-week schedule, sim week, view team standings, player stats leaders, and team box scores
Use Sonner for toasts (already present in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx) for key notifications like Touchdown, Interception, Fumble, Field Goal Good, or Game Over
Ensure high contrast on dark surfaces and complete accessibility for all interactive buttons and cards.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not build plain gray panels. Use broadcast sports styling with team color accents, crisp 1px borders, bold condensed headers, LED scoreboard text, and tactile 3D dice visuals.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain clean generous padding (p-4 to p-8) and well-balanced grid gaps so the telemetry and scoreboard feel readable and un-cluttered.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Never set 'transition: all' in global CSS. Apply transitions specifically to hover and background states to prevent transform flickering during dice rolls or play animations.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_readiness: Every interactive button, tab, dropdown, metric display, and table row MUST have data-testid attributes attached.
